mcp.name: add_vessel
mcp.description: Register a new vessel (git repository) in a fleet

mcp.name: apply_backlog_refinement_summary
mcp.description: Apply a refinement summary back to the linked backlog item and optionally promote its backlog state. Ends the session and releases its captain unless endSession is false.

mcp.name: apply_fleet_recommendations
mcp.description: Apply fleet recommendations to an import batch: reuses tenant fleets with the same name (case-insensitive) or creates them, and assigns each listed vessel. Pass fleets to apply an edited list, or omit it to apply the captain's stored recommendations unchanged. A fleet named Uncategorized is not created. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: approve_deployment
mcp.description: Approve a pending deployment and begin execution.

mcp.name: backup
mcp.description: Create a ZIP backup of the Armada database and settings for disaster recovery. Uses SQLite online backup API for a consistent snapshot.

mcp.name: cancel_fleet_action_run
mcp.description: Cancel a fleet action run: pending targets are cancelled, running commands are killed, and unlanded voyages of a Mission run are cancelled.

mcp.name: cancel_merge
mcp.description: Cancel a queued merge entry

mcp.name: cancel_mission
mcp.description: Cancel a specific mission

mcp.name: cancel_voyage
mcp.description: Cancel an entire voyage and all its pending missions

mcp.name: categorize_vessel_import
mcp.description: Run or retry fleet categorization for an import batch whose import finished: a captain reads a manifest of the batch's selected repositories and recommends fleets (FleetCategorization background job). Omitted arguments reuse the batch's previous captain, prompt, and auto-apply choice. Poll the batch (enumerate entityType vessel_import_batch, or the job) until categorizationStatus is Completed, Failed, or Applied. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: cli_permission_prompt
mcp.description: Permission prompt tool for CLI captains (Claude Code --permission-prompt-tool). Only callable by a captain's own mission- or Ask-thread-scoped session; people decide requests with decide_cli_permission_request. Waits until an approver allows or denies the call, a CLI permission rule decides it, or it expires, then returns {"behavior":"allow","updatedInput":{...}} or {"behavior":"deny","message":"..."}.

mcp.name: create_backlog_item
mcp.description: Create a backlog item that can link vessels, planning sessions, voyages, checks, releases, deployments, and incidents.

mcp.name: create_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Create a repository-aware planning session from a backlog item while preserving the objective linkage.

mcp.name: create_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Start a captain-backed refinement session for a backlog item. The caller must specify the captain explicitly.

mcp.name: create_captain
mcp.description: Register a new captain (AI agent)

mcp.name: create_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Create a CLI permission rule (admins). A matching deny rule denies a captain's permission prompt without asking; a matching allow rule allows it. Scope Global applies to every captain of the tenant (a global admin may omit tenantId to apply it to every tenant), Vessel to missions on one vessel, Captain to one captain.

mcp.name: create_deployment
mcp.description: Create a bounded deployment record and execute it immediately when approval is not required.

mcp.name: create_fleet
mcp.description: Create a new fleet (collection of repositories)

mcp.name: create_fleet_action
mcp.description: Create a reusable fleet action. Kind Command runs commandText in each vessel's working directory (tenant admin only); kind Mission dispatches one voyage per vessel from promptTemplate. Templates may use {{vessel.name}}, {{vessel.id}}, {{vessel.defaultBranch}}, {{vessel.workingDirectory}}, {{vessel.buildCommand}}, {{health.summary}}.

mcp.name: create_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Pre-register a Harbor. A Harbor also self-registers on first handshake; use this to reserve a name/capacity before it connects.

mcp.name: create_memory
mcp.description: Create a durable memory, or update it in place when a memory with the same key already exists (idempotent consolidation). Classify the content as Episodic (what happened/when), Semantic (a standalone fact), or Procedural (how to do something). Working memory is never stored.

mcp.name: create_mission
mcp.description: Create and dispatch a standalone mission to a vessel

mcp.name: create_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Create a managed model endpoint. Kind must be one of Embedding, Inference; Provider is one of Ollama, OpenAI, OpenAICompatible, Anthropic, Gemini, VoyageAI, AzureOpenAI, VertexAI, Bedrock. Anthropic cannot be used for Embedding and VoyageAI cannot be used for Inference.

mcp.name: create_objective
mcp.description: Create an internal-first objective or intake-style record that can link vessels, planning sessions, voyages, checks, releases, deployments, and incidents.

mcp.name: create_persona
mcp.description: Create a new persona with a name and prompt template reference

mcp.name: create_pipeline
mcp.description: Create a new pipeline with an ordered sequence of persona stages

mcp.name: create_playbook
mcp.description: Create a new markdown playbook.

mcp.name: create_prompt_template
mcp.description: Create a new prompt template.

mcp.name: create_release
mcp.description: Create a first-class release record from linked voyages, missions, and structured checks, with derived version, notes, and artifacts when available.

mcp.name: decide_cli_permission_request
mcp.description: Allow once, allow and remember (store an allow rule; admins only), or deny a pending CLI permission request. Deciding requires a global admin or a tenant admin of the request's tenant, or the mission or thread owner when Permissions.AllowOwnerApproval is on. Requires a credential (not the unauthenticated loopback identity) and is refused for captain sessions, so a captain can never approve its own prompt.

mcp.name: delete_backlog_item
mcp.description: Delete one backlog item and its snapshot history.

mcp.name: delete_captain
mcp.description: Delete a captain. If working, the captain is recalled first.

mcp.name: delete_captains
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple captains from the database by ID. Captains that are Working or have active missions are skipped. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Delete a CLI permission rule (admins of the rule's tenant).

mcp.name: delete_dock
mcp.description: Delete a dock and clean up its git worktree. Blocked if the dock is actively in use by a captain.

mcp.name: delete_docks
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple docks and their git worktrees from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_event
mcp.description: Delete a single event by ID. Permanently removes the event from the database.

mcp.name: delete_events
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple events from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_fleet
mcp.description: Delete a fleet by ID

mcp.name: delete_fleet_action
mcp.description: Delete a fleet action. Built-in actions are soft-deleted and never re-seeded. Past runs are kept.

mcp.name: delete_fleets
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple fleets from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Delete a Harbor registration by ID.

mcp.name: delete_memory
mcp.description: Delete a memory by id. Use this to remove a memory that has become stale or is no longer relevant.

mcp.name: delete_merge
mcp.description: Permanently delete a terminal merge queue entry from the database. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_missions
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple missions from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Delete a managed model endpoint by ID.

mcp.name: delete_objective
mcp.description: Delete one objective/backlog entry and its snapshot history.

mcp.name: delete_persona
mcp.description: Delete a persona by name. Built-in personas cannot be deleted.

mcp.name: delete_pipeline
mcp.description: Delete a pipeline by name. Built-in pipelines cannot be deleted.

mcp.name: delete_playbook
mcp.description: Delete a playbook by ID. Existing mission snapshots remain immutable.

mcp.name: delete_signals
mcp.description: Soft-delete multiple signals by marking them as read. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries.

mcp.name: delete_vessel
mcp.description: Delete a vessel by ID

mcp.name: delete_vessels
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple vessels from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_voyages
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple voyages and their associated missions from the database by ID. Voyages that are Open/InProgress or have active missions are skipped. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: discover_vessels
mcp.description: Discover git repositories on the Admiral host to onboard as vessels. Scans the given directories and roots (breadth-first, skipping excluded and dot-prefixed folders, worktrees, and Armada's own directories) and saves the result as an import batch. Creates no vessels; call import_vessels with the returned batchId to import. Requires tenant admin. Paths must be inside Import.AllowedRoots (or the user profile when none are configured).

mcp.name: dispatch
mcp.description: Dispatch a new voyage with missions to a vessel

mcp.name: dispatch_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Dispatch a voyage from a planning session and keep the linked backlog item associated with the resulting voyage.

mcp.name: enqueue_merge
mcp.description: Add a branch to the merge queue for testing and merging

mcp.name: enumerate
mcp.description: Find and browse entities with paginated, filtered, sorted access to: objectives, fleets, vessels, captains, missions, voyages, docks, signals, events, merge_queue, personas, prompt_templates, pipelines, playbooks, workflow_profiles, project_profiles, skills, check_runs, releases, deployments, incidents, runbooks, runbook_executions, vessel_import_batch, fleet_action, fleet_action_run, fleet_action_run_target, and vessel_health. Returns paginated results with total counts. Filter by vesselId, fleetId, captainId, voyageId, status, date range, and more.

mcp.name: evaluate_autoland
mcp.description: Dry-run the vessel's auto-land predicate against a mission's captured diff without landing it. Returns whether the change would auto-land and, if not, the hold reason.

mcp.name: evaluate_vessel_health
mcp.description: Start a background vessel health evaluation job for specific vessels, a fleet, or every active vessel. Returns jobId; alreadyRunning is true (and nothing starts) when an evaluation is already running for the tenant. Poll the job with enumerate entityType jobs or GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: fleet_action_run_status
mcp.description: Get a fleet action run with per-target summaries (status, skip/failure reason codes, exit code, voyage id, output length hints). Output text is not included.

mcp.name: get_backlog_item
mcp.description: Inspect one backlog item including linked repositories, planning sessions, voyages, releases, deployments, incidents, and acceptance criteria.

mcp.name: get_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Inspect one planning session created from backlog/objective work, including its transcript and linked backlog items.

mcp.name: get_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Inspect one backlog refinement session, including its transcript, captain, vessel, and linked backlog item.

mcp.name: get_captain
mcp.description: Get details of a specific captain (AI agent)

mcp.name: get_captain_log
mcp.description: Get the current session log for a captain. Supports pagination.

mcp.name: get_captain_tools
mcp.description: Describe the runtime-visible tool sources and named tools available to a specific captain.

mcp.name: get_check_run
mcp.description: Inspect one structured check run including status, output, artifacts, parsed test summary, and coverage summary.

mcp.name: get_cli_permission_request
mcp.description: Get one CLI permission request visible to the caller.

mcp.name: get_deployment
mcp.description: Inspect one deployment including approval, verification, rollback, linked checks, and request-history evidence.

mcp.name: get_dock
mcp.description: Get a dock (git worktree) by ID.

mcp.name: get_fleet
mcp.description: Get details of a specific fleet including its vessels

mcp.name: get_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Inspect one registered Harbor (host runner) by ID, including its advertised capabilities and connection status.

mcp.name: get_memory
mcp.description: Read a single memory by id, including its full content.

mcp.name: get_merge_entry
mcp.description: Get details of a specific merge queue entry

mcp.name: get_mission_diff
mcp.description: Get the git diff of changes made by a captain for a mission. Returns saved diff if available, otherwise live worktree diff.

mcp.name: get_mission_log
mcp.description: Get the session log for a mission. Supports pagination.

mcp.name: get_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Inspect one managed model endpoint (embedding or inference) by ID. The API key is never returned.

mcp.name: get_objective
mcp.description: Inspect one objective including linked repositories, planning sessions, voyages, releases, deployments, incidents, and acceptance criteria.

mcp.name: get_persona
mcp.description: Get a persona by name

mcp.name: get_pipeline
mcp.description: Get a pipeline by name, including its stages

mcp.name: get_playbook
mcp.description: Get a playbook by ID.

mcp.name: get_prompt_template
mcp.description: Get a prompt template by name. Resolves from database first, falls back to embedded defaults.

mcp.name: get_release
mcp.description: Inspect one release record including linked voyages, missions, checks, versions, tags, notes, and derived artifacts.

mcp.name: get_runbook
mcp.description: Inspect one runbook including parameters, bound workflow profile, environment, and step structure.

mcp.name: get_runbook_execution
mcp.description: Inspect one runbook execution including completed steps, notes, and deployment or incident linkage.

mcp.name: get_vessel
mcp.description: Get details of a specific vessel (repository)

mcp.name: health_check_model_endpoints
mcp.description: Run a health sweep across all enabled model endpoints, deduplicated by base URL, and refresh their health status. Returns the number of distinct base URLs probed.

mcp.name: import_vessels
mcp.description: Import candidates from a discover_vessels batch as vessels. Pass the candidate paths to import, or allNew=true to import every candidate with status New. Each vessel gets RepoUrl = origin URL (or the local path), WorkingDirectory = the discovered path, and no LocalPath. Paths that already have a vessel are skipped. Large selections run as a background job (returns jobId; poll the batch with enumerate entityType vessel_import_batch or get the job). Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: inbox
mcp.description: Return the operator's inbox: everything across the fleet that requires a human's attention or action right now, ordered most-urgent first. Use this to answer questions like "Is there anything waiting on me?", "Is there anything that needs my attention?", or "Do I have any action items from Armada work?". It surfaces two kinds of item: (a) work awaiting your decision (human-in-the-loop) -- missions in Review to approve or reject, deployments pending approval, and Ask Armada action proposals waiting for the caller's approval; and (b) autonomous work that failed and needs intervention (human-out-of-the-loop) -- failed missions, missions whose work could not land (landing failed), failed merges, failed or verification-failed deployments, and stalled captains. Purely informational events such as completions or normal progress are deliberately excluded. Each item has: kind, severity (Critical, Warning, or Info), title, detail, the related entity (entityType and entityId), and a dashboard href. Deployment items also carry environmentName and deploymentTitle, and a deployment approval is titled with the environment first and the deployment title second ("Deploy to production: Release 2.3 hotfix"). An empty items list means nothing currently needs the operator's attention.

mcp.name: list_backlog
mcp.description: Enumerate backlog items with optional vessel, fleet, status, backlog-state, priority, and free-text filters.

mcp.name: list_backlog_refinement_sessions
mcp.description: List captain-backed refinement sessions for one backlog item (lightweight, paginated). Returns session metadata only, most-recently-updated first; fetch a session's transcript with get_backlog_refinement_session.

mcp.name: list_cli_permission_requests
mcp.description: List CLI permission requests (a CLI captain asking to run one of its own tools, for example a shell command) visible to the caller, newest first. Admins see their tenant (global admins every tenant); other users see requests from their own missions and Ask conversations. Each request has the tool name, a redacted input summary, captain, vessel, mission or thread, status, expiry, and canDecide.

mcp.name: list_cli_permission_rules
mcp.description: List CLI permission rules visible to the caller (the caller's tenant plus rules for every tenant). Rules use Claude Code permission rule syntax, for example Bash(git status:*), WebFetch(domain:example.com), or Edit(//repo/src/**); deny rules win over allow rules.

mcp.name: list_objectives
mcp.description: Enumerate backlog objectives with optional vessel, fleet, status, backlog-state, priority, and free-text filters.

mcp.name: list_prompt_templates
mcp.description: List prompt templates (lightweight, paginated), optionally filtered by category. Returns metadata only -- name, category, description, active flag, and a contentLength hint -- not the template body. Fetch a single template's full content with get_prompt_template.

mcp.name: mission_status
mcp.description: Get status of a specific mission

mcp.name: papercut_summary
mcp.description: List friction that captains reported during missions, collapsed into groups of the same vessel, category, and problem. Use the count and distinct-captain count to tell a one-off from a real defect, then promote a group to a backlog item or objective.

mcp.name: process_merge_entry
mcp.description: Process a single merge queue entry by ID: creates integration branch, runs tests, and lands if passing

mcp.name: process_merge_queue
mcp.description: Process the merge queue: creates integration branches, runs tests, and lands passing batches

mcp.name: purge_dock
mcp.description: Force purge a dock and its git worktree, even if a mission references it. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_entries
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple terminal merge queue entries from the database by ID. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be purged. Returns a summary of purged and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_entry
mcp.description: Permanently delete a single terminal merge queue entry from the database by ID. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be purged. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_queue
mcp.description: Permanently delete all terminal merge queue entries (Landed, Failed, Cancelled) from the database. Optionally filter by vessel ID and/or status. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_mission
mcp.description: Permanently delete a mission from the database. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_voyage
mcp.description: Permanently delete a voyage and all its missions from the database. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: release_captain
mcp.description: Lift a captain's quarantine, returning it to the Idle pool so tier selection can hand it work again.

mcp.name: reorder_backlog_items
mcp.description: Apply one or more explicit backlog rank updates using backlog terminology.

mcp.name: reorder_objectives
mcp.description: Apply one or more explicit backlog rank updates using objective-compatible tool naming.

mcp.name: repair_dock
mcp.description: Repair a dock's git worktree to fix a corrupted or relocated registration. Non-destructive: no work is removed.

mcp.name: reset_prompt_template
mcp.description: Reset a prompt template to its embedded resource default content. Only works for built-in templates.

mcp.name: restart_mission
mcp.description: Restart a failed or cancelled mission, resetting it to Pending for re-dispatch. Optionally update title and description (instructions) before restarting.

mcp.name: restore
mcp.description: Restore the Armada database and settings from a ZIP backup file. Creates a safety backup of the current state before overwriting. Server restart recommended after restore.

mcp.name: retry_check_run
mcp.description: Retry a previously completed structured check run using the same resolved scope and command context.

mcp.name: retry_landing
mcp.description: Retry landing for a mission in LandingFailed status. Rebases the mission branch onto the current target and re-attempts landing.

mcp.name: rollback_deployment
mcp.description: Run the configured rollback flow for an existing deployment.

mcp.name: run_check
mcp.description: Start a structured check run for a vessel using the resolved workflow profile or an explicit command override.

mcp.name: run_fleet_action
mcp.description: Start a fleet action run over vessels. Pass actionId to run a saved action, or the inline definition fields (name, kind, commandText or promptTemplate) for an ad hoc run. Every vessel must be in the caller's tenant or the whole request is rejected. Returns the run id; poll fleet_action_run_status.

mcp.name: search_memory
mcp.description: Search durable memories (episodic/semantic/procedural). Use this BEFORE writing to find existing memories to consolidate against. Returns matches ordered by salience, newest first.

mcp.name: send_backlog_refinement_message
mcp.description: Append one user message to a backlog refinement session and launch the next captain turn.

mcp.name: send_signal
mcp.description: Send a signal/message to a captain

mcp.name: set_captain_cli_permission_policy
mcp.description: Set or clear a captain's CLI tool permission policy (Refuse, ApproveInArmada, or Bypass; omit policy to inherit). Requires a global admin or a tenant admin of the captain's tenant. Bypass runs the CLI with its permission-bypass flag (for example --dangerously-skip-permissions): the captain can run any command as the Admiral's user.

mcp.name: set_harbor_enabled
mcp.description: [Experimental] Enable or disable a Harbor for routing. A disabled Harbor keeps its docks but receives no new missions.

mcp.name: set_vessel_health_override
mcp.description: Set (or with remove=true, remove) a manual status override for one vessel health criterion, or for Overall. Effective statuses are recomputed immediately from stored findings. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: start_runbook_execution
mcp.description: Start a guided runbook execution with optional parameter overrides and deployment or incident context.

mcp.name: status
mcp.description: Get aggregate status of active work in Armada: captain counts by state, mission counts by status, active voyages with progress, and recent signals. A global administrator sees every tenant; any other caller sees only its own tenant.

mcp.name: stop_all
mcp.description: Emergency stop all running captains

mcp.name: stop_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Request stop for one active backlog refinement session and release the selected captain.

mcp.name: stop_captain
mcp.description: Stop a specific captain agent, killing its process and recalling it to idle state

mcp.name: stop_server
mcp.description: Initiate a graceful shutdown of the Admiral server

mcp.name: summarize_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Create or select a structured backlog-refinement summary from one refinement session.

mcp.name: token_usage_summary
mcp.description: Summarize model token usage over a time window: time buckets with a per-model breakdown, a whole-window per-model aggregate ordered most-used first, and grand totals (input, output, cached, total). Counts are real where the runtime reports usage (for example Claude Code) and estimated otherwise -- estimatedCount reports how many aggregated records were estimated.

mcp.name: transition_mission_status
mcp.description: Transition a mission to a new status with validation (the same rules as PUT /api/v1/missions/{id}/status). Valid transitions: Pending->Assigned/Cancelled, Assigned->InProgress/Cancelled, InProgress->WorkProduced/Testing/Review/Complete/Failed/Cancelled, WorkProduced->PullRequestOpen/Complete/LandingFailed/Cancelled, PullRequestOpen->Complete/LandingFailed/Cancelled, Testing->InProgress/Review/Complete/Failed, Review->InProgress/Complete/Failed, LandingFailed->WorkProduced/Failed/Cancelled. Complete, Failed, and Cancelled are terminal.

mcp.name: unstick_dock
mcp.description: Unstick a wedged dock: release any captain still holding it back to Idle and reclaim its worktree so it stops pinning capacity. Committed branch history is preserved.

mcp.name: update_backlog_item
mcp.description: Update one backlog item, including prioritization, category, linked entities, and refinement metadata.

mcp.name: update_captain
mcp.description: Update a captain's name or runtime. Operational fields (state, process, mission) are preserved.

mcp.name: update_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Update a CLI permission rule's pattern, action, and description (admins of the rule's tenant).

mcp.name: update_fleet
mcp.description: Update an existing fleet

mcp.name: update_fleet_action
mcp.description: Update a fleet action. Only the supplied fields change. Built-in actions can be edited.

mcp.name: update_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Update a Harbor's operator-editable fields (name, capacity, enabled).

mcp.name: update_memory
mcp.description: Update an existing memory by id. Only supplied fields change. Use this to reconcile or augment an existing memory rather than creating a duplicate.

mcp.name: update_mission
mcp.description: Update an existing mission's title, description, priority, vessel, voyage, branch, or PR URL. Operational fields (status, timestamps, captain) are managed by the system.

mcp.name: update_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Update a managed model endpoint. Only supplied fields change; omit apiKey to keep the stored key.

mcp.name: update_objective
mcp.description: Update one objective/backlog entry, including prioritization, category, linked entities, and refinement metadata.

mcp.name: update_persona
mcp.description: Update an existing persona's properties

mcp.name: update_pipeline
mcp.description: Update an existing pipeline's properties and stages

mcp.name: update_playbook
mcp.description: Update an existing playbook.

mcp.name: update_prompt_template
mcp.description: Update a prompt template's content and description. Creates the template if it does not exist.

mcp.name: update_vessel
mcp.description: Update an existing vessel's properties

mcp.name: update_vessel_context
mcp.description: Update a vessel's project context and style guide without modifying other properties

mcp.name: validate_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Validate a model endpoint by issuing a real request (an embedding for embedding endpoints, a short completion for inference endpoints) and update its health status.

mcp.name: verify_deployment
mcp.description: Run post-deploy verification for an existing deployment.

mcp.name: vessel_health
mcp.description: Get one vessel's health: the row with effective (override-aware) statuses, raw findings (criterion, status, detailCode, valueA, valueB), and manual overrides. Dependency rows are excluded by default (dependencyCount hint returned); set includeDependencies to include them.

mcp.name: voyage_status
mcp.description: Get status of a specific voyage. Returns summary with mission counts by default; opt-in to full mission details.
